source: Official Vinamilk annual and sustainability report PDFs already downloaded from the URLs recorded in data/vietnam_enterprises/manifest.json.
reference_method: PyMuPDF native PDF text extracted from each selected page; diagnostic reference only, not manually transcribed ground truth.
language_label_method: Dominant visible language of each rendered evaluation page was checked visually; it does not inherit the language suffix from the document ID.
limitations: Born-digital pages only; native text may contain extraction errors or differ in reading order. Not representative of scanned, skewed, low-resolution or degraded documents. Layout and table accuracy are not labeled. Do not use these scores to select a production OCR model or make thesis accuracy claims until references are manually checked.
